before.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。 此前比较方向提出独立机制约束下的跨条件接续，以及重构和选择关系自身的改变。 新的24小时形成实测与常规模型进一步接通建立条件和留存占比；较低离散的优势取决于相对生长，反例保留。 已完成的演化组织说明进一步接通实际取样、继承发育状态与跨转移重建；组织改变后续取样结果，真实供给及后续修订均保留。 原始显微数据现核对真实尺度及逐位置拍摄时钟，混合培养两段采集的位置配置可接续；成像对应与培养物身份仍分别论证。 直接同等网络比较现证明重构机制具有精确的常规实现，包含依当前状态选择及失败行动。 Ren现明确要求聚焦理论：复用形成、重构、更新器及目的修订成果，比较其独立前提与额外解释，当时选定具体联结论学习结果的恢复。 预先固定视野的91帧现接成实测发育史；增长后的局部消失与轨迹的边界删失分别保留，观察结束不独自说明结构丧失。 新理论连接把后继重建能力接到完整回返路径的选择阈值及繁殖代价；直接外形延续可下降，第一代相同产出仍可掩盖相反的增长条件。 现已恢复单步Hebb方向，有限循环发育的后果响应由规律导出；tanh符号相容条件保持方向，并支持有限关系改变，反馈和选择关系改变可反转局部增益。 有限组装程序现从实际消耗及成功停止共同推出P列产出和重建比例；成功概率不同于后继比例，额外尝试可提高成功却消除增长优势。既有类型的增长因子接入相邻规则入侵条件。 新的共同历史由逐项非线性选择推出留存关系：同一网络从不完整线索重现两种格局，持续偏向一方造成旧格局失去重现能力，继续修订又能恢复；当前选择改善不保证保留旧能力。 实际传递组成与保留接触机会现导出局部成功率，后继自行重建成键；同一亲代、同平均成键率和接触消耗仍可因后继间机会分布不同而产生不同重建。不同种类传播体的响应不能无条件压成同一个回返系数。 后续同史构造把反复干扰造成的实际反应失败接到更新器维持与替换：由原生发育算出回报差别，保留旧关系与剩余支持，新规则实际改变后续更新并取得维持所需支持。 三阶段接续现证明条件性的有限周期回返，平衡混合时可用发育后响应的均值合并；成熟亲代的准备规律仍须实现。 组成生成与付费安放现实现指定亲代准备：同类生成使原先接触重建优势倒转，互补生成又改变排序；失败保留未用组成和支持，未完成指定返回不等于死亡。 参考接触现取得未知仿射通道的实际读数，形成的局部比较与抑制连接推出响应式更新，并在保留网络及支持记录中运行；校准后的通道变化可造成实际误报并阻止修复。 新参考比较现决定保留或修订已取得的读数，并实际恢复原网络更新；有限工作段之间可以改变通道。仿射通道零点相同、增益同向恰好保留全部符号判断，参数变化不独自等于能力丧失。 生长与断键现从实际连接图导出后继成员，接入共同材料准备；同组成及同边数可有不同共同传递，均匀断键与最老边先断使排序反转。新形成的替代维持关系还可使原有断键不再导致群体分裂。
before.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants. Earlier comparative work proposed continuation across conditions constrained by independent mechanisms, followed by changes in reconstruction and selection relations. New 24-hour observations and a conventional model connect establishment to retained representation; lower dispersal gains only under the relative-growth condition, with an adverse contrast preserved. The completed evolutionary-organization account now connects actual sampling, inherited developmental state and reconstruction across transfers; formed organization changes later sampling, with actual provision and subsequent revision retained. Original microscopy now supplies checked scale and position-specific capture times, with continued position configuration across two rescue acquisitions; imaging correspondence and culture identity remain distinct. A direct matched-network comparison now establishes an exact conventional realization of the reconstruction mechanism, including shared state-dependent selectors and failed actions. Ren now directs a theoretical focus: reuse formation, reconstruction, updater and goal-revision results, compare their independent premises and added explanation, and selected recovery of a specific connectionist learning result. A predefined field now has a measured 91-frame developmental history; local disappearance after growth is distinguished from boundary censoring, so an observation ending does not alone establish structural loss. A new theoretical connection gives a full-cycle selection threshold and reproductive cost ceiling for inherited reconstruction; direct resemblance can fall, and identical first-generation outputs can conceal opposite growth conditions. The single-step Hebbian direction is now recovered. Finite recurrent sensitivity follows from the developmental law; a sign-compatible tanh regime preserves the direction through finite changes, while feedback and changed selective relations can reverse local gains. A finite assembly programme now derives P-column production and reconstruction jointly from paid attempts and stopping. Success probability differs from the descendant fraction, and added attempts can improve success while removing growth advantage. The resident factor enters an adjacent-rule invasion condition. A new common history derives retained relations from coordinate-wise nonlinear selection: the same network recalls two patterns from incomplete cues, continued emphasis on one destroys old recall, and further revision restores it. Current-score improvement does not guarantee preservation of an earlier capacity. Actual transmitted components and retained contact slots now determine local success, with each successor rebuilding its own bond. The same parent, mean encounter rate and cost can yield different reconstruction because opportunities are distributed differently across successors. Distinct seed responses cannot unconditionally be collapsed to one return coefficient. A subsequent common history connects actual response failures from repeated interference to updater maintenance and replacement: native development determines return differences, old relationships and remaining support persist, and the new rule governs later updates and earns renewal. A three-stage continuation proves conditional finite-cycle return and permits aggregation by the mean developed response under a balanced mixture; common mature-parent preparation still requires realization. Component production and paid routing now realize preparation of the specified parent: same-type production reverses the contact reconstruction ranking, while complementary production changes it again. Failed preparation retains components and work; missing the specified return does not establish death. Reference contacts now acquire actual readings of unknown affine channels. Formed local comparisons and inhibition derive responsive updating and operate in the retained network/support history; channel changes after calibration can cause false success and suppress repair. Fresh reference comparison now determines retention or revision of acquired readings and restores native updating across finite blocks with changed channels. Equal zero and same gain orientation exactly preserve the all-input affine sign interface; parameter change alone does not establish lost capacity. Growth and actual edge removal now derive successor membership from formed connections and join common material preparation. Equal composition and edge counts can yield different cotransmission; uniform and oldest-edge cuts reverse the ranking. A newly formed alternative retention route can also prevent a formerly separating cut from fragmenting the group.

before.scope_en: Preserves 16/26, 19/41, 7/13 and 6/6 theorem/audit results and counterexamples; seven new local-balance theorems / eleven audits pass. The 54 videos/18 technical replicates, 33/190 sensitivity, 3,808 records/3,600 links, 42/72 versus 7/72, 3,424 forecasts and 139-cohort/485-row checks retain their scopes. Eight growth and two competition summaries cannot become cycle probabilities. Initial absence versus later loss, joint calibration, broad comparison and support renewal remain open. Four original movies are preserved and 44 selected-frame correspondences pass; frames are not replicates. Exact genotype attribution, acquisition timing and linked descendants remain incomplete; no cycle probability is fitted. The new direction assessment is complete; ecological scaffolding, endogenization and evolutionary connectionism are strong comparators. Superiority is unestablished, with no new forecast or theorem. New checks cover 45 cultures/11 dated cohorts, preserving a 784-versus-769 count ambiguity and numerical capacity failure; event integration is an explicit model adaptation. The focused account is complete at the selected scope: 20 new Lean theorems / 44 new declaration audits / 113 closure audits. Finite-history inheritance and reconstruction do not establish invasion stability or indefinite renewal; primary interventions and strong comparators are assessed, while broad superiority remains unestablished. New checks cover 4,383 directory entries, 388 timestamps, 114 first/last image records and two complete pixel fields; scene offsets reach 225.89 seconds and the restart gap is 337.39 seconds. Treatment/endpoint identity, interior trajectories and six-day descendants remain unjoined; no new theorem. Eleven new Lean theorems / 24 new audits and 34,768 executed comparisons establish equivalence under matched laws, not Watson-model replication or an empirical win. The direct comparison is closed; independently constrained joint empirical prediction remains open. The theoretical integration and author counterreview are complete, with no new theorem. Internal premise reduction is distinct from demonstrated comparative economy; the ethical extension discloses G0 and further commitments. Empirical calibration is not this task’s theoretical completion gate; broad superiority remains unestablished. New checks cover 91 image subblocks and 23,855,104 crop pixels, preserving detection and movement sensitivity. Four longest assigned tracks include local-loss candidates and a still-visible boundary object; no collapse rate, descendant join or new theorem is asserted. Twenty-eight new Lean theorems / forty audits cover finite-history bounds and conditional identification. Mesoscopic production, routing and transmission remain supplied, not derived from cell events. Conventional life-cycle models retain full credit; the then-pending connectionist recovery is addressed below, while broad superiority remains open. Twenty-nine new Lean theorems / 41 declaration audits pass under explicit developmental and selection laws. Finite adverse cases and supplied native laws, initial states and mutation/transmission premises remain. The named directional recovery is complete; memory, interference and continued revision across patterns were its selected continuation. No new empirical prediction or broad novelty is claimed. Thirty-seven new Lean theorems / fifty-seven audits pass, with 166 closure audits. The finite programme connection is complete; trial success, copying, mature output and renewal remain supplied. A separate-averages approximation has an opposite growth sign; the equally informed conventional mechanism agrees. No new empirical result or broad superiority is claimed. The developmental-memory connection now has 28 new Lean theorems / 44 new declaration audits, with 41 inherited audits separately rebuilt; ambiguous-cue failure is preserved. Scope is sign recall with self-interactions and full-decay tanh. Adapted training profiles, proposals, step size, schedule and readout horizons remain explicit. The bounded multi-pattern memory connection is complete; interference consequences entering update-rule formation or revision were its selected continuation. Capacity, amplitude convergence, biological applicability and full-theory completion are not claimed. The contact reconstruction connection adds 30 Lean theorems / 57 new audits, with 223 closure audits. It replaces the independent success rate and parental bond flag in this construction without reusing the old offspring formula. Compatibility, uniform replacement sampling, partition formation and mature-stage provision remain explicit. A one-cycle comparison is not invasion; partition formation/cost and a population interface retaining seed distinctions are next. Strong spatial models retain full credit. Consequence-dependent updater replacement adds 36 Lean theorems / 57 new audits, with 85 inherited audits separately rebuilt. One-step full-profile readout, two available rules, faithful success, construction and support laws remain explicit. Failed old-rule replacement, no gain on unchanged tasks, extra cost, false reports and source exhaustion are preserved. This finite replacement connection is complete; construction of the responsive rule and reliable access from local relations was its selected continuation, with no population-frequency, ethical-necessity or broad-superiority claim. Material maturation adds 28 Lean theorems / 44 new audits, with 267 closure audits. The finite preparation connection is complete; return follows from actual composition-dependent growth and routing. Production laws, routing recipe/capabilities, slot geometry, partition formation and supplies remain explicit. Primary comparison is not replication or superiority. Formation, inheritance and revision of reproductive recipes and partitions are next; completed material preparation is reused. Acquired discrimination and updater construction add 30 Lean theorems / 59 new audits, with 142 inherited audits separately rebuilt. Stable nonzero affine channels, bound references, component laws, an assembly plan and ten extra construction units/four parts at entrance remain explicit. Missing contact, constant channels, underfunding and altered transfer are preserved. This local correspondence is complete; maintaining reference-to-use correspondence through change was its selected continuation. Generic calibration/formation results are not reopened; no population, ethical or broad-superiority conclusion follows. Reference renewal adds 34 Lean theorems / 50 new audits, with 201 inherited audits separate. Actual six-reading comparison and supported commitment replace a correct change alarm. Seven units per block suffice; common within-block relations, bound references, the exact affine class and inspection schedule remain explicit. Zero-only checks, six-unit revision failure, constant channels, late change, mixed references and nonaffine aliasing retain limits. This finite inspection connection is complete; actual maintenance or bounded departure of reference-to-use relations is next, with no self-funding, universal-reliability or evolutionary-superiority claim. Growth-to-fragmentation adds 31 Lean theorems / 59 new audits, with 326 closure audits separated. The formerly assigned partition is derived in this bounded construction. Developmental schedule, differentiation, fracture occurrence, catalytic correspondence and finite support remain explicit. The common eight-slot preparation requires the whole pool with no excess and does not regenerate either grown graph. Reconstruction/transmission of operative growth and retention relations with responsive fracture is next; completed finite fragmentation and maturation are not reopened. Primary biophysical and spatial accounts retain credit; no broad superiority follows.

after.claim_zh: 活动后果可改变后继形成与选择条件，贡献变体不必获益。重构、发育与聚合区分遗传群体和运输集合；细菌回复实验接通遗传切换与周期完成。谱系预测保留总体优势及局部失败。新增原始实证支持呼吸形成氧梯度并改变后续选择；结构形成史须接入发育迁移，常规解释获完整信用。 原始延时研究进一步记录界面小筏形成、下落和再形成；酸碱条件改变空间组织，须与持续膜结构和实际后代分别对应。 此前比较方向提出独立机制约束下的跨条件接续，以及重构和选择关系自身的改变。 新的24小时形成实测与常规模型进一步接通建立条件和留存占比；较低离散的优势取决于相对生长，反例保留。 已完成的演化组织说明进一步接通实际取样、继承发育状态与跨转移重建；组织改变后续取样结果，真实供给及后续修订均保留。 原始显微数据现核对真实尺度及逐位置拍摄时钟，混合培养两段采集的位置配置可接续；成像对应与培养物身份仍分别论证。 直接同等网络比较现证明重构机制具有精确的常规实现，包含依当前状态选择及失败行动。 Ren现明确要求聚焦理论：复用形成、重构、更新器及目的修订成果，比较其独立前提与额外解释，当时选定具体联结论学习结果的恢复。 预先固定视野的91帧现接成实测发育史；增长后的局部消失与轨迹的边界删失分别保留，观察结束不独自说明结构丧失。 新理论连接把后继重建能力接到完整回返路径的选择阈值及繁殖代价；直接外形延续可下降，第一代相同产出仍可掩盖相反的增长条件。 现已恢复单步Hebb方向，有限循环发育的后果响应由规律导出；tanh符号相容条件保持方向，并支持有限关系改变，反馈和选择关系改变可反转局部增益。 有限组装程序现从实际消耗及成功停止共同推出P列产出和重建比例；成功概率不同于后继比例，额外尝试可提高成功却消除增长优势。既有类型的增长因子接入相邻规则入侵条件。 新的共同历史由逐项非线性选择推出留存关系：同一网络从不完整线索重现两种格局，持续偏向一方造成旧格局失去重现能力，继续修订又能恢复；当前选择改善不保证保留旧能力。 实际传递组成与保留接触机会现导出局部成功率，后继自行重建成键；同一亲代、同平均成键率和接触消耗仍可因后继间机会分布不同而产生不同重建。不同种类传播体的响应不能无条件压成同一个回返系数。 后续同史构造把反复干扰造成的实际反应失败接到更新器维持与替换：由原生发育算出回报差别，保留旧关系与剩余支持，新规则实际改变后续更新并取得维持所需支持。 三阶段接续现证明条件性的有限周期回返，平衡混合时可用发育后响应的均值合并；成熟亲代的准备规律仍须实现。 组成生成与付费安放现实现指定亲代准备：同类生成使原先接触重建优势倒转，互补生成又改变排序；失败保留未用组成和支持，未完成指定返回不等于死亡。 参考接触现取得未知仿射通道的实际读数，形成的局部比较与抑制连接推出响应式更新，并在保留网络及支持记录中运行；校准后的通道变化可造成实际误报并阻止修复。 新参考比较现决定保留或修订已取得的读数，并实际恢复原网络更新；有限工作段之间可以改变通道。仿射通道零点相同、增益同向恰好保留全部符号判断，参数变化不独自等于能力丧失。 生长与断键现从实际连接图导出后继成员，接入共同材料准备；同组成及同边数可有不同共同传递，均匀断键与最老边先断使排序反转。新形成的替代维持关系还可使原有断键不再导致群体分裂。 实际逐步变化与噪声现推出取得读数的误差界，原生网络推出反应余量；工作段内通道可持续改变而在充分年龄窗口内保留实际修复及后续两类记忆。区间跨界保留不确定，可靠性取决于关系变化与辨别余量的共同条件。
after.claim_en: Consequences can change successor formation and selection without guaranteeing contributor advantage. Reconstruction, development and aggregation distinguish inherited clusters from transport groups; bacterial reversion links switching to cycle completion. Lineage forecasts retain aggregate gains and local failures. Primary evidence now links respiration-generated oxygen gradients to changed selection; structural development must enter transferable prediction. Conventional explanation receives full credit. Original time-lapse research adds recurring surface rafts and pH-sensitive spatial organization, requiring separate correspondences for persistent mat structure and actual descendants. Earlier comparative work proposed continuation across conditions constrained by independent mechanisms, followed by changes in reconstruction and selection relations. New 24-hour observations and a conventional model connect establishment to retained representation; lower dispersal gains only under the relative-growth condition, with an adverse contrast preserved. The completed evolutionary-organization account now connects actual sampling, inherited developmental state and reconstruction across transfers; formed organization changes later sampling, with actual provision and subsequent revision retained. Original microscopy now supplies checked scale and position-specific capture times, with continued position configuration across two rescue acquisitions; imaging correspondence and culture identity remain distinct. A direct matched-network comparison now establishes an exact conventional realization of the reconstruction mechanism, including shared state-dependent selectors and failed actions. Ren now directs a theoretical focus: reuse formation, reconstruction, updater and goal-revision results, compare their independent premises and added explanation, and selected recovery of a specific connectionist learning result. A predefined field now has a measured 91-frame developmental history; local disappearance after growth is distinguished from boundary censoring, so an observation ending does not alone establish structural loss. A new theoretical connection gives a full-cycle selection threshold and reproductive cost ceiling for inherited reconstruction; direct resemblance can fall, and identical first-generation outputs can conceal opposite growth conditions. The single-step Hebbian direction is now recovered. Finite recurrent sensitivity follows from the developmental law; a sign-compatible tanh regime preserves the direction through finite changes, while feedback and changed selective relations can reverse local gains. A finite assembly programme now derives P-column production and reconstruction jointly from paid attempts and stopping. Success probability differs from the descendant fraction, and added attempts can improve success while removing growth advantage. The resident factor enters an adjacent-rule invasion condition. A new common history derives retained relations from coordinate-wise nonlinear selection: the same network recalls two patterns from incomplete cues, continued emphasis on one destroys old recall, and further revision restores it. Current-score improvement does not guarantee preservation of an earlier capacity. Actual transmitted components and retained contact slots now determine local success, with each successor rebuilding its own bond. The same parent, mean encounter rate and cost can yield different reconstruction because opportunities are distributed differently across successors. Distinct seed responses cannot unconditionally be collapsed to one return coefficient. A subsequent common history connects actual response failures from repeated interference to updater maintenance and replacement: native development determines return differences, old relationships and remaining support persist, and the new rule governs later updates and earns renewal. A three-stage continuation proves conditional finite-cycle return and permits aggregation by the mean developed response under a balanced mixture; common mature-parent preparation still requires realization. Component production and paid routing now realize preparation of the specified parent: same-type production reverses the contact reconstruction ranking, while complementary production changes it again. Failed preparation retains components and work; missing the specified return does not establish death. Reference contacts now acquire actual readings of unknown affine channels. Formed local comparisons and inhibition derive responsive updating and operate in the retained network/support history; channel changes after calibration can cause false success and suppress repair. Fresh reference comparison now determines retention or revision of acquired readings and restores native updating across finite blocks with changed channels. Equal zero and same gain orientation exactly preserve the all-input affine sign interface; parameter change alone does not establish lost capacity. Growth and actual edge removal now derive successor membership from formed connections and join common material preparation. Equal composition and edge counts can yield different cotransmission; uniform and oldest-edge cuts reverse the ranking. A newly formed alternative retention route can also prevent a formerly separating cut from fragmenting the group. Actual successive changes and noise now imply acquired-reading error bounds, while native network responses imply a positive margin. Channels may keep changing within a block while actual repair and subsequent two-memory retention persist through a sufficient age window. Intervals crossing the boundary retain uncertainty; reliability depends jointly on relational change and discrimination margin.
